【是否购买道具‘避雷针’】

系统尽职尽责的询问第二遍。

此时雷电已经消失了，时笙抬头看了看天，晴空万里，刚才那雷哪里来的？叶清秋渡劫的时候没缓冲完的？

她买个避雷针来做什么？插头上吗？

“刚刚怎么回事？不是已经渡劫完成了吗？怎么还有雷电？”

“不知道啊，这情况闻所未闻。”

“那雷电比之前的粗你们发现没有？而且……我感觉那威力好像也更厉害，站这么远我都感觉很不舒服。”

“前面有好几个人被震出血了……”

“什么？这么厉害？这是什么雷？难不成叶宗主要晋升神族？”

“开什么玩笑，神界早就没了，怎么晋升神族？”

那人的话引起了不少人的嗤笑。

说话的那人不过是随口一说，此时被人这么奚落嘲笑，顿时就来了气，和那些人吵了起来，眼看吵架就要演变成打架。

就在此时。

光线突然一暗，晴空万里的天空被厚重的乌云覆盖，前后不过眨眼的时间，那些乌云就像是凭空出现的一般。

时笙万万没想到那些雷是冲自己来的，在乌云出现的瞬间，凤辞就被一股无形的力量弹飞。

而就在凤辞弹飞的瞬间，十几道雷电同时从天上落下，毫无预兆。

这些雷电比叶清秋渡劫的那些雷电大了一圈不说，叶清秋是一道一道的劈，尼玛她是十几道一起劈！

区别对待也不是这样的啊！

这些雷电根本就不能避开，只有让它劈到，它才会消失。

之前出现的那十几道，明显是来清场的！

总算知道系统问她要不要避雷针的用途了！

可是，为毛现在系统没反应了啊摔！

本宝宝要买避雷针。

从外面看，时笙所在的区域，被一片紫光笼罩，根本看不到里面的人。

[Host, do you want to purchase the prop ‘Lightning Rod’]

Shrimp stuff?What kind of lightning protection do you want her to buy for no reason?

Wasn't it Ye Qingqiu who was hacked?

[Whether to purchase the prop ‘Lightning Rod’]

The system dutifully asked the question a second time.

At this time, the thunder and lightning had disappeared. Shi Sheng looked up at the sky. The sky was clear. Where did the thunder come from?Ye Qingqiu didn't finish buffering when he was going through the tribulation?

Why did she buy a lightning rod?On the plug?

"What happened just now? Hasn't the tribulation been completed? Why is there still thunder and lightning?"

"I don't know, this is unheard of."

"Did you notice that the lightning was thicker than before? And... I feel that the power seems to be more powerful. I feel very uncomfortable standing so far away."

"Several people in front were shocked and bleeding..."

"What? So powerful? What kind of thunder is this? Is it possible that Zong Ye wants to be promoted to the God Clan?"

"Are you kidding me? The God Realm has long since disappeared. How can I be promoted to the God Clan?"

The man's words caused many people to laugh.

The person who spoke was just saying something casually. When he was ridiculed and laughed at, he immediately became angry and started to quarrel with those people. It was about to turn into a fight.

Right now.

The light suddenly dimmed, and the clear sky was covered by thick dark clouds. In the blink of an eye, those dark clouds seemed to appear out of thin air.

Shi Sheng never expected that those thunders were coming towards him. The moment the dark clouds appeared, Feng Ci was bounced away by an invisible force.

And at the moment Feng Ci flew away, more than a dozen thunder and lightning fell from the sky at the same time without any warning.

These thunderbolts were much bigger than those that Ye Qingqiu had experienced during his tribulation. Ye Qingqiu struck them one after another, but she struck them dozens of times at the same time!

This is not the case with differential treatment!

These lightnings cannot be avoided at all, and they will only disappear if they are struck by them.

The dozen or so people who appeared before were obviously here to clear the place!

Finally understood the purpose of the system asking her if she wanted a lightning rod!

However, why is the system unresponsive now?

This baby wants to buy a lightning rod.

From the outside, the area where Shi Sheng was located was shrouded in purple light, and no one inside could be seen at all.
